gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-fauna-one: Baloo Chettan 2 has wide channels running into every counter, so its text looks magnified even when it isn't. The heading projects; Fauna One murmurs, dignified and literary, with shallow ascenders.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-glegoo: Baloo Chettan 2 looks magnified, with wide channels into each counter. It earns its keep big and brief, while Glegoo adds a refined, editorial feel through big counters and open-mouthed curves.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-graduate: Dignified and bookish, with generous white between letters, this body sits quietly beneath Baloo Chettan 2. Graduate has near-capital lowercase and uniform stems, so a modest size will do.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-hanuman: Showy up top, restrained below, with Baloo Chettan 2 doing the shouting. Hanuman's high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals look refined and traditional, and are worth giving a little extra size.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-kadwa: Loud and distinctive up top, with wide channels running into every counter of Baloo Chettan 2. Kadwa, with its open-ended curves and large x-height, would crowd the heading if enlarged, while a tiny heading loses its magnified look.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-piazzolla: Wide channels leading into every counter make Baloo Chettan 2 look magnified without growing a point. Piazzolla can stay modest in size; its lowercase nearly matches the capitals.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-scope-one: Wide channels leading into each counter give Baloo Chettan 2 an expressive, magnified look. Scope One then settles things down, with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, its rounded letters showing large, clear openings. And Baloo Chettan 2 does the expressive part, its wide channels making text look magnified, leaving sobriety to Slabo 13px.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-suwannaphum: Big, expressive, slightly magnified: that's Baloo Chettan 2. It excels at standing out through wide channels into its counters, while Suwannaphum, dignified and editorial, offers an open c and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-epunda-slab: Baloo Da 2 stands its lowercase almost cap-tall and spreads the terminals of its s wide apart. Epunda Slab matches that with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms, so openness is the shared trait.
